scripts.build: npm run build -w @pbi-lens/core && npm run build -w pbi-lens && npm run build -w pbi-lens-vscode && npm run build -w @pbi-lens/mcp
scripts.watch: npm run build && concurrently -n core,cli,mcp -c blue,green,magenta "npm run watch -w @pbi-lens/core" "npm run watch -w pbi-lens" "npm run watch -w @pbi-lens/mcp"
